hints.title: Run-Length Representation
hints.text: Decompose strings into character runs and their consecutive frequencies.

hints.title: Run Extension Validation
hints.text: A query word run can stretch to match the target run if they share the character and target run length is either identical or at least three.

hints.title: Sequential Component Matching
hints.text: Compare run-length blocks in parallel. If any character mismatches, query run exceeds target run, or target run is two with different query length, the word is not expressive.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Run-length compression followed by pairwise block comparisons.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Regular expressions or string permutations lead to exponential backtracking.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Run-length tuples use O(S + L) temporary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Enforce the condition that expansion requires target run length >= 3.
